notes.title: Patch 1.4
notes.content:
- fixed bugs
- improved performance
- adjusted difficulty

notes.title: Patch 1.3
notes.content:
Czech language was added! (Big shout out to Komunitní překlady!)

- Lighting update
- Candles casts shadows
- Added new details
- Option to interact with weapons laying around
- Theobald health increased 30%
- AI Cooldown for light attacks decreased from 5s to 3s

notes.title: Patch 1.2
notes.content:
Happy New Year, everyone and a massive shoutout to each of you for your incredible support!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44763553/cd61d9de9b3600170eca97387b6948790599a3d9.png[/img]

- Fixed the resolution change bug.
- Fixed the bug where NPCs disappeared after buying a new weapon.
- Fixed the bug where the player couldn't move after using the latrine or sitting at the fireplace.
- Fixed a bug where William trained without a sword.
- Fixed a bug where Dietrich attacked Alryk without a weapon when dialogue lines were skipped.
- Fixed the hint for opening the Journal while using a gamepad.
- Added collision to the arena fence
- Increased the time required to trigger a charge attack when using a mouse (from 25ms to 40ms).
- Increased the speed of the charge attack.
- Shortened the stun duration for the player when posture is broken.
- Corrected some grammar issues.

notes.title: Patch 1.1
notes.content:
Hello everyone and thank you for the overwhelming support this demo has received, this patch will have few additions and fixes based on previous feedback. please enjoy!

[list]
[*] Added 3 New Achievements 
[*] Improved visibility of tutorial hints.
[*] Added hints for opening the journal and turning its pages.
[*] Fixed a bug where the player gets stuck outside the arena in the evening.
[*] Fixed a hole that allowed leaving the area.
[*] Fixed cat interaction.
[*] Decreased the loudness and frequency of cat sounds.
[*] Added mouse sensitivity settings.
[*] Added new achievements.
[*] Fixed the KP icon on the Windows bar.
[*] Tuned down hit, block, and deflection visual effects (VFX).
[*] Adjusted the duration of stun and faint animations.
[/list]
